title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes V
notes: The designer's fifth Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4353). Keywords: an Indestructible Unit card is Immutable innately, never adding the keyword, so no Transform, Vanilla, Fuse-onto, Nerf or Buff reaches it (R4353000; Indestructible Field Spells are not, so Ivory Tower, Heroic Power, In Too Deep and Rod of Ages keep their fusing and tuning); Immutable bars no targeting, R781001's targeting half and R781002 superseded, so Tesla damages and Twice Forward copies an Immutable card (R4353001); Evasive gains Hearthstone's Elusive, no Spell or Field Spell targeting it in play (R4353002); Supernova's fresh Alnilam still takes the board in (R4353003). Cards: Repeater v5 Activate 4 and 2%4 damage, the Beams 3%6, 5%10 and 7%14, Silly Silas (6) with Float reduces cost and no longer summoned for the opponent, Basket of Crawlers 2, Legacy: Speciesist (3) 7/1, Speciesist (2) 4/1 losing 1 mana next turn (R4353021), Medina Enforcer (3) 4/7 on an Activate, Jlockeed Shredder-12's base face without Pierce, A Glimpse into the Endless Sea's fatigue immunity (R4353020), Mindustrial Revolution adding at once (R4353022), Open Enrollment Embiggened (2) (R4353023), Mend Projector's +Health (R4353024, R4353025 for Silas), Accelerationist +3%+6, Thorium Wall 0/10 and 0/40, Job Application (0), Noxious Rounds (3); each changed script keeps its v0.6.8b one (R767000). Rulings R4353000-R4353003 and R4353020-R4353025.

player.title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes V
balance: Repeater v5 is Activate 4, up from Activate 3, and deals 2 damage (Radiant 4), down from 3 (Radiant 6).
Beam v5 deals 7 damage (Radiant 14), down from 8 (Radiant 16); Beam v4 deals 5 (Radiant 10), down from 6 (Radiant 12); Beam v3 deals 3 (Radiant 6), down from 4 (Radiant 8).
Silly Silas costs (6), up from (4), is no longer summoned for your opponent, and gains "Float reduces cost." on both faces.
Basket of Crawlers adds 2 Crawlers, down from 3.
Legacy: Speciesist costs (3), up from (2), and is 7/1 (Radiant 14/2), up from 2/1 (Radiant 4/2).
Speciesist costs (2), down from (3), and is 4/1 (Radiant 8/2), down from 7/1 (Radiant 14/2); its Cry also leaves you 1 less mana next turn.
Medina Enforcer costs (3), up from (2), and is 4/7 (Radiant 8/14), up from 4/4 (Radiant 8/8); it Buffs every card in your hand with an Activate, once a turn, instead of at the end of your turn.
Jlockeed Shredder-12 loses Pierce; its Radiant face keeps it.
A Glimpse into the Endless Sea also makes you immune to fatigue damage for the rest of the game.
Mindustrial Revolution also adds its Mindustrial card at once when you cast it.
Open Enrollment gains Embiggened (2): the cards it adds cost (1) less (Radiant: they cost (0)).
Mend Projector also gives every Unit it heals +1 Health (Radiant +2).
Accelerationist has +3/+3 (Radiant +6/+6) for every card that Evolved this game, up from +2/+2 (Radiant +4/+4).
Thorium Wall is 0/10 (Radiant 0/20), up from 0/8 (Radiant 0/16), and Embiggened 0/40 (Radiant 0/80), up from 0/32 (Radiant 0/64).
changes: Indestructible Units are Immutable too: nothing transforms, Silences, Nerfs, Buffs or fuses onto them. Indestructible Field Spells are not.
Immutable no longer stops Spells, Field Spells and Field Traps from targeting a card; they still can't change its text.
Evasive cards can't be targeted by Spells or Field Spells, yours or your opponent's, while they are on the field.
